podcast.title: Hollywood-Based Operation
podcast.body: Rascal Records was a label based in Hollywood. It originated from a company that initially existed only on paper and was owned by a relative of the band DA. "Rascal records did exist. They were in Hollywood."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Limited Releases
podcast.body: The label released a few other singles besides "Ready and Steady" by DA, but it never issued any other recordings from DA. "And yes, Rascal did release a few other singles, but nothing ever again, from DA."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
